visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men, one with black hair in a dark sweater and another with pink hair in a white and green pullover, sit on a grey sofa in a brightly lit room with grey curtains. They hold a large white gift box labeled 'THANK YOU' and speak enthusiastically to the camera. (2) A close-up shows the box being opened to reveal a teal interior with a black and white checkered board design and the YouTube logo on top. Confetti graphics appear on screen as they unveil the contents. (3) The men continue to interact with the gift, laughing and gesturing. The pink-haired man gives a thumbs-up while the black-haired man points at the box, showing visible excitement and joy. (4) The camera focuses on the interior of the box which contains a custom chess set with clear and black acrylic pieces. A small nameplate inside reads '黃氏兄弟' next to the YouTube play button icon. (5) They examine the chess pieces, holding them up to the camera. The setting remains constant with the sofa and curtains in the background. (6) The pink-haired man holds a white envelope with a red YouTube logo and pulls out a card to read a message. The black-haired man watches attentively, leaning in towards the card. (7) He unfolds a long paper strip showing various channel statistics like '133.3M' and '2.3M'. They react with wide eyes and open mouths, clearly impressed by the numbers. (8) The video concludes with both brothers posing behind the chess set, hands folded or gesturing towards the camera in a gesture of gratitude.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo pop background music with a clear electronic beat begins immediately. Two male voices speak with high energy and enthusiasm. Their speech rate is fast with frequent pitch fluctuations indicating excitement. (2) The sound of the large box lid opening creates a soft cardboard rustling noise. The voices remain high in arousal as they react to the visual reveal of the chess set. (3) A sudden burst of laughter and a slightly louder vocal exclamation occurs as one brother jokingly reacts to a minor physical mishap. The BGM remains steady in the background at a moderate volume. (4) One voice begins reading a written message with a slightly more controlled, narrative tone, though still warm and friendly. The pace slows down slightly during the reading. (5) High-volume reactions and fast-paced chatter return as they read out channel milestones. The percussive elements of the BGM are clearly audible, matching their energetic delivery. (6) A short melodic vocalization (singing 'do-re-mi') occurs towards the end, followed by a final statement of thanks. The BGM fades out as the video ends.
